title.en: A part's merge kept by the rest
title.zh: 部分的合并由其余部分承接

statement.en: Under a law that merges nothing, possibilities no two alike, read by a part and a rest that tell them apart, number at most the part's count times the rest's at every step: a part's narrowing spreads the rest, and a part reset at every step needs a whole no list holds.
statement.zh: 在不合并的律下，两两不同的可能性，由能把它们区分开的部分与其余部分读取，在每一步至多是部分之数乘以其余之数：部分的收窄由其余部分承接，每一步都被重置的部分需要没有列表容纳的整体。

laws.en: Where a part and a rest together tell configurations apart, k configurations no two of which coincide, their parts held by ps and their rests by es, number at most ps.length times es.length.
laws.zh: 部分与其余部分合起来能区分构形时，两两不同的 k 个构形，其部分由 ps 容纳、其余部分由 es 容纳，至多有 ps.length 乘以 es.length 个。

laws.en: Under a law that merges nothing, possibilities no two alike are, any number of steps on, still no two alike; so at every step k of them number at most the count of a list holding their parts times that of a list holding their rests. Narrowed to one part, every list holding their rests has at least k members; in a rest of N, the parts need a list of at least k / N.
laws.zh: 在不合并的律下，两两不同的可能性在任意多步之后仍然两两不同；所以在每一步，k 个这样的可能性至多是容纳其部分的列表之数乘以容纳其余部分的列表之数。部分收窄为一个时，容纳其余部分的每个列表至少有 k 个成员；其余部分有 N 个时，部分需要至少 k / N 个。

laws.en: Where a law merges nothing and after every step a part reads one configuration, then if any configuration has another part no list holds every configuration: a part reset at every step passes what it loses into a rest that grows without bound.
laws.zh: 律不合并而每一步之后部分都读出同一个构形时，只要有某个构形的部分不同，就没有列表容纳所有构形：每一步都被重置的部分，把它所失去的传入无界增长的其余部分。

laws.en: Witness Reset: a one-bit part set to false at every step, the bit it held passing onto a kept list. The whole merges nothing, the part merges at every step, and the rest grows by one at every step, so no list holds it along any run and none holds the whole: the kept history (withHistory) restricted to the part.
laws.zh: 见证 Reset：一位的部分每一步都被置为 false，它所持的位传入一个被保存的列表。整体不合并，部分每一步都合并，其余部分每一步增长一，所以在任何运行上都没有列表容纳它，也没有列表容纳整体：限于该部分的保存历史（withHistory）。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. A law that merges nothing; a part and a rest that together tell configurations apart; possibilities no two alike; lists holding parts and rests where named. For the reset law, a part reading one configuration after every step and some configuration with another part.
hypotheses.zh: 不用公理。不合并的律；合起来能区分构形的部分与其余部分；两两不同的可能性；在所指之处容纳部分与其余部分的列表。重置之律还需每一步之后部分读出同一个构形，且有某个构形的部分不同。

does_not_show.en: Landauer's bound in energy: no energy, temperature, probability or bath is read, so kT ln 2 is not derived; the step from a count to heat (S = k ln W, heat at least T times the entropy a bath at temperature T receives) stays a physical premise.
does_not_show.zh: Landauer 以能量计的下限：这里不读能量、温度、概率或热库，所以不推出 kT ln 2；由计数到热的一步（S = k ln W，温度为 T 的热库所得之热至少是 T 乘以它所得的熵）仍是物理前提。

does_not_show.en: That actual microscopic laws merge nothing: that is Liouville's theorem or unitarity, read by correspondence.
does_not_show.zh: 实际的微观律不合并：这是 Liouville 定理或幺正性，经对应读出。

does_not_show.en: Any new mathematics: this is Landauer's (1961) phase-space count, with Bennett's history (1973) as the witness.
does_not_show.zh: 任何新的数学：这是 Landauer（1961）的相空间计数，以 Bennett 的历史（1973）为见证。

Built and reviewed in one session, with no separate reviewer; author review in study section 255; the literature check before building is the significance review's least-loss section; not independently reviewed by a person.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261020T104831.571462Z）：Becoming.LeastLoss 的声明公理报告为空；检查器核验核心的纯粹性。在一个会话中构建与审查，没有另外的审查者；作者自审见研究第 255 节；构建之前的文献检查是意义审查的最小损失一节；未经人独立审查。

next_delta.en: A reading of count as energy, so that the periphery's floor (DestroysAtLeast at kT ln 2) follows from this count with only that reading supplied; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 把计数读作能量，使外围的下限（kT ln 2 处的 DestroysAtLeast）只需给出这一读法即由此计数推出；独立审查。

correspondence.en: Landauer (1961): a logically irreversible step compresses the phase space of the information-bearing degrees of freedom, and Liouville's theorem makes the rest expand. Bennett (1973; SHPMP 34, 2003, "in a sense ... a restatement of the Second Law"); Ladyman, Presnell, Short and Groisman (SHPMP 38, 2007; disputed by Norton). The finite-rest floor is the counting shadow of Reeb and Wolf's finite-bath correction (NJP 16, 2014) and Masanes and Oppenheim's unattainability (Nat. Commun. 8, 2017). Reading (the AI's): a part that keeps itself narrow, as an organized system does, passes the distinctions it loses into its surroundings, and in a finite world it can do so only so far.
correspondence.zh: Landauer（1961）：逻辑上不可逆的一步压缩承载信息的自由度的相空间，Liouville 定理使其余部分扩张。Bennett（1973；SHPMP 34，2003，“在某种意义上……是第二定律的重述”）；Ladyman、Presnell、Short 与 Groisman（SHPMP 38，2007；Norton 有异议）。有限其余部分下的下限，是 Reeb 与 Wolf 的有限热库修正（NJP 16，2014）与 Masanes 与 Oppenheim 的不可达性（Nat. Commun. 8，2017）在计数上的投影。读法（AI 的）：一个使自身保持收窄的部分，如有组织的系统，把它失去的区分传入周围，而在有限的世界中只能做到某个程度。

aliases: a part's merge kept by the rest
部分的合并由其余部分承接
possibilities conserved by a lossless law

detail.en: Reuses Law.Lossless.cancel (merging nothing at a step, merging nothing over any number of steps), Law.Lossless.returns, Law.returns_iff, revisits_within and unlisted_of_new.
detail.zh: 复用 Law.Lossless.cancel（一步不合并，任意多步不合并）、Law.Lossless.returns、Law.returns_iff、revisits_within 与 unlisted_of_new。

output.en: A law that merges nothing keeps configurations apart and, within finitely many, returns every one.
output.zh: 不合并的律使构形保持不同，并在有限多个之内使每一个返回。

input.en: Possibilities kept apart, counted in a product of lists; every configuration after a step.
input.zh: 保持不同的可能性，在列表之积中计数；每个构形都在一步之后。

detail.en: The converse of Law.loss_needs_merge there: a loss needs a merge, and inside a whole that merges nothing a part's merge needs room in the rest.
detail.zh: 那里 Law.loss_needs_merge 的反面：损失需要合并，而在不合并的整体中部分的合并需要其余部分有余地。

detail.en: There Landauer's floor is a physical premise (DestroysAtLeast); here its count is a core law.
detail.zh: 那里 Landauer 的下限是物理前提（DestroysAtLeast）；这里其计数是核心规律。

detail.en: The other half of LC1: rest with no least loss over a finite reading.
detail.zh: LC1 的另一半：有限读取上没有最小损失的停息。

history.en: 20 October 2026: added (LC1), section 8.1 item 6: the converse of Law.loss_needs_merge in a whole that merges nothing; study section 255.
history.zh: 2026年10月20日：新增（LC1），第 8.1 节第 6 项：在不合并的整体中 Law.loss_needs_merge 的反面；研究第 255 节。
